items.notes: Official distributor confirmed as Jaidah Heavy Equipment (Jaidah Group), new Isuzu showroom opened in Doha (Gulf Times). No promotion page, finance offer or campaign surfaced in 26 searches; only Qatar Living asking prices for new 2026 D-Max (QR 79,000 4x2 / QR 89,000 4x4) and MU-X (~QR 128,000). Aggregator list price D-Max 2026 QAR 58,000-88,000.

models_without_offer: X3 / X3 Pro (only old glimpse of QR 43,900)
items.notes: Dealer Al Waha For Cars (Mawater City); aggregator text also names 'KAIYI Qatar / Al Wahab Automobiles'. Offers found are dealer listing prices on qic.online / Qatar Living (X7 2025 QAR 65,000-69,000 with warranty + service package) and an aggregator statement about instalment plans with no down payment. X3 'Not Sold Here' on drivearabia; X7 2026 'Coming Soon'. A Bahrain Kaiyi X3 Pro offer (Asia Motors) surfaced but is not Qatar.

Taleb Trading Co. is the historic Daihatsu dealer (named in MEC recalls 2015/2017). Aggregators show 'Not Sold Here' for Gran Max/Terios/Sirion; no showroom, price list or offer found. Effectively absent from new-car offers.

Ibin Ajayan Trading is the distributor (Gulf Times launch of Scorpio Pik-Up, undated/old). No Qatar price list, listing or promotion found in 14 searches; Facebook 'exclusive offers' hint could not be verified via search.
No official NIO dealer in Qatar (drivearabia: 'Not Sold Here', price not available for EL8/ET5/EC6). Middle East presence is Abu Dhabi NIO House. No offers.
No official Seres dealer in Qatar; drivearabia shows Seres 5 SF at QAR 200,000-205,000 (price page only, 2023-2025). AITO entered UAE only (Feb 2026). No offers.

models_without_offer: T01 Navigator / Adventure trims (no official Qatar launch price found; drivearabia est. QAR 120,700)
items.notes: Al Waha For Cars is exclusive 212 distributor; showroom opened 3 Nov 2025 (Peninsula/Zawya). Found Al Waha listings for 212 Station 2026 at QAR 99,000-115,000 incl. warranty & service package, 2025 unit at QAR 89,000, Qatar Living T01 listings QAR 89,000-99,000, plus Mall of Qatar raffle (1 Sep-31 Oct 2026) with a 212 Adventure as prize. No formal finance/registration campaign found.
No Acura dealer or listings in Qatar; only a ccarprice.com converted price (ADX A-Spec Advance 2026 ~QR 154,336) which is not a dealer price. No offers.

Alfardan Sports Motors (The Pearl) is the authorised reseller (Peninsula 2019) and launched the Tonale in Qatar (factqatar); drivearabia nonetheless lists no official dealer. Only offer found is the August 2019 summer campaign (range from QR 109,000 with 5-year/120,000 km service & warranty), recorded as expired. 2026 list prices: Tonale QAR 201,000-215,000, Giulia 219,000-220,000, Stelvio 275,000-276,000, Giulia QV 419,000-420,000, Stelvio QV 455,000-460,000.
No Baojun dealer, listing or price page for Qatar; Wuling appears only as grey imports. No offers.
